LESSON: READING 1.2.1 INDEPENDENT READING - GRADE APPROPRIATE TEXT

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.2: Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it important to read different types of materials?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read grade appropriate materials for lifelong learning
2. create a reading log for monitoring reading activities

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. read grade appropriate materials for lifelong learning
   In simple words: practise until you can read grade appropriate materials for lifelong learning. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. create a reading log for monitoring reading activities
   In simple words: practise until you can create a reading log for monitoring reading activities. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text.
4. Show that you can: read grade appropriate materials for lifelong learning

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 1.2.1 Independent Reading - Grade Appropriate Text important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Learning to learn: It takes place as the learner builds on their own learning experience when selecting reading materials.
2. Critical thinking and problem solving: It is promoted as the learner follows simple instruction to develop a good reading culture.
3. Self-efficacy: It is nurtured as the learner shows concerted attention when creating a reading log. Values:
4. Responsibility: It is inculcated as the learner engages in assigned roles when searching for reading materials, reads, and keeps a reading log.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read grade appropriate materials for lifelong learning
2. create a reading log for monitoring reading activities

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
